package.description: Provides linting capabilities for authoring extensions.

API proposal versions are no longer supp.en: API proposal versions are no longer supported. Remove the '@<version>' suffix.

Data URLs are not a valid image source..en: Data URLs are not a valid image source.

Embedded SVGs are not a valid image sour.en: Embedded SVGs are not a valid image source.

Images must use the HTTPS protocol..en: Images must use the HTTPS protocol.

Relative badge URLs require a repository.en: Relative badge URLs require a repository with HTTPS protocol to be specified in this package.json.

Relative image URLs require a repository.en: Relative image URLs require a repository with HTTPS protocol to be specified in the package.json.

SVGs are not a valid image source..en: SVGs are not a valid image source.

This activation event can be removed as.en: This activation event can be removed as VS Code generates these automatically from your package.json contribution declarations.

This activation event cannot be explicit.en: This activation event cannot be explicitly listed by your extension.

This proposal cannot be used because for.en: This proposal cannot be used because for this extension the product defines a fixed set of API proposals. You can test your extension but before publishing you MUST reach out to the VS Code team.

Using '*' activation is usually a bad id.en: Using '*' activation is usually a bad idea as it impacts performance.
